title: Sage on the Stage
lines: Ben brings his pet rat to class.
He has a huge cage up on the stage.
"This is Sage," he said. "He is my rat."
Sage hops from the cage and runs off!
The class jumps up, but Ben is brave.
He calls, "Sage! Sage!" Sage will not stop.
Ben sets a bit of ham on a page.
Sage smells the ham and runs back.
Ben picks him up and shuts the cage.
"That rat and his ham!" said Ben.

questions.ask: What does Ben do first when Sage runs off?
questions.listenFor: He calls Sage by name, but Sage will not stop. Send them back to that line.

questions.ask: What finally gets Sage to come back?
questions.listenFor: A bit of ham that Ben sets on a page. If they say "the ham," ask where Ben put it.

questions.ask: Do you think Ben had a good plan? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason, such as "yes, because Sage came back for the ham."
